problems.reason: Sentence 5 places Hydrotherikornis in Procellariiformes, whereas earlier it is described as an auk (family Alcidae), which belongs to Charadriiformes. The two classifications contradict each other.

notes: - contradiction: "The genus Hydrotherikornis belongs to the parent group Procellariiformes.": Sentence 5 places Hydrotherikornis in Procellariiformes, whereas earlier it is described as an auk (family Alcidae), which belongs to Charadriiformes. The two classifications contradict each other.
